features included: Small transverse through-hole (two cylindrical segments in B-rep)
Section.function intent: Provide a transverse fastening/locking/locating feature (e.g., roll pin, dowel, set-screw passage, or alignment feature) through the upper block.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a bearing surface for a pin/screw; introduces local stress concentration managed by surrounding block thickness.
Section.geometry: Small diameter cylindrical hole running across the part in the x-direction, represented as two cylindrical faces due to B-rep splitting.
Section.location: Upper block region around y≈137, near mid-thickness.
